task: Fix portal/v1.1.0 sign job receiving digest null: producer uses a key imagetools does not write; validate at producer and consumer; add recovery dispatch

events.summary: Only portal-docker-publish.yml, one new unit test, the lessons-log row and this trace change. Signing key/secret handling and cosign flags are untouched.

Run 38747268314: merge job step 'Create manifest list and push' wrote digest=$(jq -r '.["containerimage.digest"]' manifest-metadata.json); sign job then ran cosign sign on IMAGE@null (could not parse reference). The index digest the registry holds is sha256:16e228757febda1b7649ce2ee79908f30a70ba41648943987fe26831d88ac30a, confirmed by docker buildx imagetools inspect --format '{{.Manifest.Digest}}' ghcr.io/dasomel/narwhal-portal:1.1.0. buildx v0.37 commands/imagetools/create.go writes {containerimage.descriptor:{mediaType,digest,size}, image.name}, so the digest key was absent.

Merge job takes the digest from the create step's containerimage.descriptor.digest (not a tag lookup), validates sha256:[0-9a-f]{64} and on a release tag cross-checks the immutable :X.Y.Z tag; sign job validates the digest, requires signing when sign_digest is set (missing secrets fail), checks the digest exists via imagetools inspect before cosign, and sign_digest reaches shell only via env. New unit tests cover these; the original ones fail on the old workflow.
